name: python-error-handling
description: Python validation, exception design, external-data parsing, and partial-failure handling.

Use for validation, exceptions, batch processing, external-data conversion, and user-friendly errors.

Validate inputs early, before expensive operations. Validate all inputs at API boundaries before any processing begins. Report all validation errors at once when possible. Validate required strings, ranges, and types before processing; raise `ValueError` with clear messages. Parse enums at boundaries and fail fast, listing valid options. Parse external data into typed domain objects at system boundaries. Use Pydantic `BaseModel`, `Field`, and `field_validator` for structured inputs.
